Welcome to ClassMitra. Your privacy is critically important to us. This Privacy Policy document contains types of information that is collected and recorded by ClassMitra and how we use it.

1. Information We Collect
We collect information to provide better services to all our users. This includes your name, email address, and the study materials you upload to interact with our AI.

2. How We Use Information
We use the information we collect from all of our services to provide, maintain, protect and improve them, to develop new ones, and to protect ClassMitra and our users.

3. AI Processing
ClassMitra uses Google Gemini AI to process your uploaded documents. Your data is sent to AI models for the purpose of generating summaries, quizzes, and flashcards. We do not use your personal notes to train global models.

4. Data Security
We work hard to protect ClassMitra and our users from unauthorized access to or unauthorized alteration, disclosure or destruction of information we hold.

5. Contact Us
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us.
